post.description: For a client advertising a tracker catalog, read tracker_catalog_get and include a tailored tracker definition. Create a goal: an END STATE the person wants to reach ("run a 10k by March", "lose 5 kg"). Never use it for a behaviour that repeats forever (drinking water daily is a routine). Steps are ONE-OFF tasks, small and concrete, 10-30 minutes, so there is always a next action.
